verdict.rationale: The pack holds only fragments of security-relevant documentation. CONTRIBUTING notes that session learnings are logged locally to `~/.gstack/projects/{slug}/learnings.jsonl`, and the domain-skills docs say agent-written per-site skills are injected into future prompt context. A community comment says gstack has usage telemetry but implies it is not prominently disclosed, so nothing here amounts to a documented security posture. Missing for 10: a dedicated security/trust-model document, documentation of what skills are permitted to execute, a trust model for third-party or agent-written skills, an explicit telemetry and data-collection disclosure with opt-out, and independent corroboration.
